cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.add.taken: There is a keyframe at the playhead already
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.add.toolti: Between keyframes: one on the path at the playhead. Otherwise: one where you stand, after the last (K while flying)
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.blend_in.t: Ticks the view glides from the player's own into the first keyframe
Ticks the view glides back to the player's own at the end
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.easing.too: How the move into this keyframe is paced
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.empty: Stand where the shot starts, look, and press + Keyframe
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.end_hold.t: Ticks the camera stays on the last keyframe before the cutscene ends
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.exit.toolt: Leaves the editor. Esc only hides this screen, so you can fly to the next keyframe
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.fade_in.to: Ticks it takes to clear from black at the start
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.fade_out.t: Ticks it takes to go to black at the end
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.fov.toolti: Field of view in degrees; 0 uses the player's own setting
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.go_to.tool: Teleports you to this keyframe (needs permission to use /tp)
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.hud: Cutscene editor: %s keyframes  |  K: add one here
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.hud.key: Cutscene editor: %s keyframes  |  K: add one here  |  %s: timeline
The aspect ratio the black bars frame; 2.39 is cinema widescreen, 0 is no bars
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.name: Name
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.new.confir: Unsaved changes: click New again to discard them
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.none_selec: Click a keyframe on the timeline to edit it
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.path.toolt: The move into this keyframe: a smooth curve, a straight line, or a cut
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.play.toolt: Plays from the playhead with the panels hidden (Space)
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.playing: Playing: click or press any key to stop
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.roll.toolt: Tilt around the line of sight, in degrees
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.save.bad_n: Name it with a-z, 0-9, _ and - only
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.save.toolt: Writes it to config/coolcatcanvas/cutscenes/ as JSON, playable as coolcatcanvas:saved/<name>
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.set_view.t: Moves this keyframe to where you stand and look
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.time.toolt: When the camera is here, in ticks (20 a second)
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.title: Cutscene Editor
cutscene.coolcatcanvas.editor.view.toolt: Look through the cutscene's camera at the playhead, or through your own eyes at its path
screen_effect.coolcatcanvas.screen.autom: Automatic: its mod turns it on and off
screen_effect.coolcatcanvas.screen.layer: Turn effects on to stack them here
screen_effect.coolcatcanvas.screen.peek: Previewing: click or press Esc to come back
screen_effect.coolcatcanvas.screen.previ: Hide this screen to see the effects; click or press Esc to come back
screen_effect.coolcatcanvas.screen.reset: Sort the layers by the order their mods chose
screen_effect.coolcatcanvas.screen.title: Screen Effects
